{{Top|leg}}
'''Tannik Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], located on the edge of the [[Manarai Heights/Legends|Manarai district]]. The headquarters of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] were located in the spaceport's upper levels.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
